target.purpose: Require reproducible multi-step feature ancestry before strict training admission.
target.central_bottleneck: Single-hop lineage labels cannot prove dataset snapshot identity, transform ancestry, parent integrity, or exactly where provenance broke.

invariants: dataset snapshots bind dataset, snapshot identity, and content hash
transform steps bind ordered parent node identities and expected fingerprints
strict training admission refuses missing or invalid lineage graphs
missing parents and parent fingerprint mismatches fail closed
terminal ancestry must reach at least one dataset snapshot
dataset snapshot changes alter graph/passport identity and break stale descendant parent references
SQL preserves normalized lineage representation while Python remains strict DAG verification authority
nonclaims: dataset snapshot and transform identities are caller-supplied unless externally attested
